title: What the Notice Does Not Know

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Eight readings go up the clay road in a locked box and one figure stands on the notice; the eight know what each house paid, the one knows only the notice, and no hand writes between the two.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Cross, in the dark month

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and forty-eight to three hundred and fifty days, six months and one hundred and sixty-eight to one hundred and seventy days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning that register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and forty-eight, forty-nine and fifty days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, never numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources. On Ash 20 the dark month's second Account-day comes to the Cross and a figure is read over the basket twice; eight arithmetics of the year then stand behind one printed figure, eight are eight and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, and the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer. No rank change, no experiment, no usable power: counting remains an old-life habit and attention remains the one thing no institution can tax. The count goes from three hundred and forty-seven to three hundred and fifty exact with six more answers on the sixth place, two hundred and seventy-six honest answers in all, each an object and not a power.
places: the flat stone by the well
the reading block under the moot-post
the moot-post's finger's width of shade

scenes.title: The Nineteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{348}{Ash 19, Ninthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Ninthday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 270 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking, and carry 347 to 348 exact, six months and one hundred and sixty-eight days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 348 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). No recap of Chapter 98: nothing from the sixteenth, seventeenth or eighteenth crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the word that came over the boards on the seventeenth went up the terrace and stands nowhere to be asked, and buys no lesson under this roof (T035/T031/T065/T095 held). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust stiff and leathery two inches off, corner a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. Composed face is not composure; a cold patient cannot clot; must be warmed from outside and slowly. The infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle; both true, the second louder, neither wins, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with a broken pot's back, says *The house will keep it*, counts intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps the charcoal unread beneath her finger, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule, the sixth held behind at Ash 2, no seventh made due. The private file is checked: seven arithmetics behind one unsigned figure, seven readings seven and not one account, finding on a place of its own with no payer; Ash's first locked up the clay road in Berr's box, Ash's second one morning ahead and named only as a date, never brought into a day that has not earned it and never supplied with an eighth early. Small hours: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake, interval held whole on the note's own finishing, straight down — answer **271**, a restraint and not a payment.

scenes.title: The Yard's Last Tends Before the Reading
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 19 through the going of the light and the bed, at the Clay Yard and its seven walked-around places, the rack end, the yard well and flat stone, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, then the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail, Ilva (once at the well, pail against her knee, strip unread, ninth hand nine); walk-ons (a Cold Acre hare-carrier answering the price with the weather and going toward the clay road with the hare unweighed, a man with a cracked jar in a rope sling sent to a pot that says nothing, a woman with a basket of kindling asking what the seventh year will want, two fence-menders saying the thaw will be early and late); Garl in objects. No Berr, no Hessa on any road, no collector, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no market, Cross or bell. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven places with a look and no number — the clean dark line with its finer grey called the thaw unswept both, the space under the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan's round ring, the trough's skin, the field's empty place on the worked strips, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone, and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085); dressed grain turned once under wool with no figure, fingers in and out without closing (T077). Ilva draws at the well with the rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in one thumb seam; to a woman asking what Ash's firings had taken she answers *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account*, hand toward the sleeve and staying, notches unread, question put answered and not the one behind it; boy files the ninth record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth and files no tenth, and she is expressly not the speaker of any voice (T080 advanced, not paid). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, checks the Ash 14 held breath and does not make it again, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word and stops — nine stoppings and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel before any person, withholds the full note known three turns ahead, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). No ownerless voice comes over the boards this afternoon and no sixth telling is made due. At the going of the light Sella sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted without a look at his face, half-beat at setting, thread left frozen, widow's mark untouched. Small hours: answer **272**.

scenes.title: Ash's Second Reading
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{349}{Ash 20, Tenthday, Y.H. 813}: before first light and through the morning at the Cross, the dark month's second Account-day and market, earned by its own morning. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Berr Clay, Hessa Rale; walk-ons (the two hundred at the Cross, eight pigs over the weigh board, the soft-cuffed clerk at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, a silent woman with a green at one corner of her mouth at the pot board turning a cup a quarter, a small shape in cast-offs with a green sliver catching the light at the market's edge). Garl in objects under the roof, not on stage here. No Ilva, no collector up or down the clay road, no ownerless voice. New day, new date, no recap; carry 348 to 349 exact, six months and one hundred and sixty-nine days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid 349 days; Garl's name unspoken the same number. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay and stands half a pace off through the reading and the bell. Berr comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, under the clay of him the smell of nothing at all; large clean hands wipe the thumb twice on the apron before touching nothing, hold a narrow slate unopened to the forearm with the writing inward, pass a finger over the figure, read *One in twelve, as the notice says* low into the goers-by and send it twice over the basket — once for the moot and once for the late households — never looking into the basket. He calls the levy and denies it with *The levy is called. It is not called by me* and *your house*, never *I*, taking himself out of his own sentence; says something low to the block about kindness being entered, and the block answers nothing; goes off up the clay road with the box locked and Ash's second true subtraction inside, believing he has done a kindness. The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself (T078); the heard bell stays in its square beside the told. Hessa takes the slate up the road toward Greybank before noon, writing to her sleeve and edge-on, her hand to it before her eyes to the crowd, answering *I don't read it. I carry it* and *I've got a road to walk* — runner and not reader, eighth hand eight with no tenth (T080). The soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the landing for a measure nobody called (T090); the green and the shape stay sightings with no eighth of either and are never Fenna or Ulda in the narration (T050/T051/T033/T034 held). Small hours: answer **273**.

scenes.title: Eight Behind One Figure
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry and the chapter's one meaningful change, no new dated heading: the afternoon after the reading, the going of the light, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons as the market thins; no Berr after he goes up the road, no Hessa seen again today, no Ilva, no ownerless voice, no collector. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T015/T041/T047, held with T077):** Ash's second true subtraction rides locked up the clay road in Berr's box beside the three of Frost and the first, second and third of Bone; **eight arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure, eight are eight and not one account**, the printed figure still one in twelve and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, and no signature on the space between. The boy files the finding on a place of its own with no payer and does not lay it across the house's not-doings, the covered grain and its empty fingers, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the fourth shaping, the turned writing or his own kept gaps; the edges come near to touching and the finger goes between. Nothing in the reading answers the hand that went in on Seed 15, the man carried out on Day 188, the dressed grain under wool, the carried fire's missing fifth, the word that went up the terrace or the room shut with the damper closed; no doctrine stands up out of eight readings, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. At the going of the light Sella carries him home at the half-pace saying nothing of what was read over him, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left frozen, widow's mark untouched because a going of the light and a bed are not openings. Tarn keeps six and the seventh, checks the held breath at the sill and does not make it again, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word and stops; Jorra keeps the dust, wheel, withheld note and damper's two bites, grows quieter and the household straightens around the quiet, the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn. Small hours: hand up an inch, small intake, interval held whole on the note's own finishing, straight down — answer **274**.

scenes.title: The Twenty-First Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{350}{Ash 21, Firstday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner, no collector this morning. New day, new date, no recap; the eighth arithmetic went up the clay road yesterday and stands behind the figure, and yesterday's reading buys no lesson under this roof. Carry 349 to 350 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid 350 days with its payer unnamed; Garl's name unspoken the same number. Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust gone stiffer and browner in the dry kiln heat, corner a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; composed face not composure, a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside. The surgeon/infant quarrel renewed: crust lifted two inches, thread wiped, hand on the pot handle — both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work. Hearth grammar at both ends of the day's opening: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, *The house will keep it*, intake and hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months not a rule, the sixth held at Ash 2, no seventh made due. Eight arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure, eight readings eight and not one account, finding on a place of its own with no payer; Ash's second no longer a date but locked and unread up the clay road, the district's arithmetic changed where two hundred people stood and not changeable back. Three hundred and fifty is not a round number anybody under this roof will speak; he has long since stopped expecting to be told what a number counts, which is not the same as not wanting it. Small hours: answer **275**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air.

scenes.title: What Eight Do Not Answer
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 21 at the Clay Yard's seven places, the yard well and flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, then the going of the light, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl in objects. Walk-ons: the Cold Acre hare-carrier answering the price with the weather, the cracked-jar man sent to a pot that says nothing, a woman with a basket of kindling, two fence-menders saying the thaw will be early and late. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no collector, no market, Cross or bell, no ownerless voice. The yard goes around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number; three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause; dressed grain lies covered and unfigured with no handful lifted. Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather; Tarn says *Yes, house* to early and late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, checks the Ash 14 held breath and does not make it again, brings the ear-sentence to the calling word and stops — nine stoppings and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled. Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note known three turns ahead, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. The whole tray is checked and left as it lay: six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her; heard bell in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, four, four and a gap; told figure beside the paid with no signature; **eight arithmetics eight and not one account**; nine record-first hands with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth; the row at five askings with one shaping and no sixth; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, and the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning each on a place of its own with a finger between every pair, none spent, named, joined, promoted into a witness, a sixth telling, a third shut-room telling, a sixth asking, a fifth shaping, a cause, a payment or a rule. Garl stays in objects and not in a story: salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey, twice-mended pot with the hairline showing, unforged collector sentence, uncalled tile debt, name unspoken three hundred and fifty days. Small hours: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake, interval held whole on the note's own finishing, straight down — answer **276**. **Two hundred and seventy-six honest answers** stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine. Count closes at **350 exact**, six months and one hundred and seventy days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid the same number with its payer unnamed; Garl's name unspoken the same. Nothing on the twenty-first was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended; Ash kept its twenty-first day without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming its months was corrected. Ash 30 (Day 359), the month's third and last Account-day, stands nine mornings ahead and is named only as a date. Forward, not closed.
